description: This Java class 'ContentKeywordIndex' manages the indexing of content for keyword search functionalities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It gathers various related data, processes keywords, and stores them into the database for efficient searching.

classes.name: ContentKeywordIndex
classes.description: Manages indexing of content entities for keyword search functionality, including gathering related data, processing keywords, and storing the index.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Triggers indexing of keywords for a given content, forcing reindexing.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method to index keywords for the provided content, with optional reindexing of all related data.

methods.name: indexKeywords (overload)
methods.description: Performs the indexing process, gathering various related data, processing keywords, and storing them in the database.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Fetches data resource content as text and adds it multiple times based on weight for indexing.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string value from a content-related entity to the list of strings to be processed for keywords.
